C1392.title: Mirai Malware Co-Author Sentenced to Home Confinement and $8.6 Million Fine
C1392.summary: One of the co-authors of the Mirai botnet was sentenced by a U.S. court to six months of home confinement, community service, and ordered to pay $8.6 million in restitution for his role in creating and deploying the malware, which built a massive botnet from IoT devices to launch large-scale DDoS attacks.
